trades.reasoning: Top-scoring candidate (95) with RSI in bullish zone, MACD bullish crossover, rising histogram, and price above SMA-20, justifying a measured deployment of idle cash above the $500 threshold with one open slot filled rather than all three on a neutral day.

decisions.briefing: Market is neutral today (NASDAQ -0.1%, S&P 500 -0.2%) with no risk-on catalyst, so existing positions are held untouched. Cash was above the $500 threshold with open slots available, so a single medium-conviction buy in BLSH was added given its strong multi-signal technical setup, while keeping most capital in reserve for a clearer risk-on signal.

market_education.summary_en: Major indices were roughly flat today, with the NASDAQ down 0.1% and the S&P 500 down 0.2%, reflecting a quiet, directionless session rather than any major shock. Without a strong catalyst, institutional participation appears light, which is consistent with the muted volume and narrow price ranges seen across most screened tickers. In this kind of environment, selective stock-picking based on individual technical strength matters more than broad market direction.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市走勢平淡，納指微跌0.1%，標普500下跌0.2%，反映市場缺乏明顯催化劑，屬於觀望性質的交易日。在沒有重大消息帶動下，機構參與度偏低，成交量亦相對溫和。在這種環境下，選股更依賴個股本身的技術面強弱，而非大市方向。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Technical confirmation means only acting on a signal when multiple independent indicators agree — for example RSI in a healthy range, a MACD bullish crossover, and price above its moving average all pointing the same direction. Relying on a single signal can lead to false starts, especially in a flat or neutral market like today's.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 技術面確認是指只有在多個獨立指標同時發出一致訊號時才採取行動，例如RSI處於健康區間、MACD出現黃金交叉、股價高於均線等同時成立。單靠一個指標容易造成誤判，尤其是在今日這種大市方向不明的環境下更為重要。
